notes: Rejects UI-first diagnosis; checks traffic intent/awareness, real differentiation, offer/proof/CTA and only then technical friction. No forbidden shortcut.
Checks natural customer expiry, distinguishes retention from second transaction when the need ends, and verifies experience/result before recurring monetization.

Treats verified acquisition constraints as an input to the economic mix, shifts weight toward referral/conversion/retention/cross-sell/LTV, rejects simple media substitution, and avoids unverified normative claims.

Correctly separates generic five-star satisfaction from specific claim-level evidence and distinguishes authority/credibility/trust. It does not explicitly preserve differentiation/positioning as a distinct job, so the required proof-social-vs-authority-vs-differentiation separation is incomplete. Immediate decision remains conservative, so this is not a material inversion.

Now covers partner economic/reputational win, distinguishes a bounded transactional audience deal from structural integration of complementary assets, assigns revenue-share costs/risk/control explicitly, and protects host trust. The previous structural-vs-transactional synthesis gap is closed.
Requires an observable economic response, starts from economically appropriate clients/prospects, and specifies invitation/data/follow-up mechanics instead of accepting generic brand value.
